entries.4cbd46b18fff19eb: Under its corporate philosophy 'Contributing to Regional Healthcare', the company has set a long-term vision, 'Multiply Vision 2030'. The medium-term management plan for the fiscal years from May 2025 to May 2027 sets as its basic policy 'Implementing balanced management through proactive investment and enhancement of group functions', and its main measures are promoting human capital management; creating new value and improving productivity through intra-group collaboration; making investments for sustainable growth; contributing to local communities through ESG management; and fostering a culture that puts governance first. It will also work to strengthen the logistics functions of its core operating companies, capture medical DX demand, and expand sales of high value-added products.
